projects.title: Iotrixa - Smart Control Hardware
projects.shortDesc: Real-time IoT telemetry system using ESP32, custom power electronics, and cloud synchronization.
projects.fullDescription:
Iotrixa is an industrial IoT hardware telemetry platform engineered for environmental monitoring and automated relay switching under Arrêté 1275.

Key Highlights:
• Custom 1-layer PCB designed in KiCad with isolated ground planes and snubber diodes to mitigate EMI.
• ESP32 executing FreeRTOS tasks for real-time sensor polling and MQTT cloud sync.
• Step-down buck power conversion with transient surge protection.

projects.title: SafeBelt - Motor Controller & Safety Board
projects.shortDesc: High-density PCB featuring custom power distribution, STM32 control, and sensor interfaces.
projects.fullDescription:
Engineered and fabricated for high-reliability embedded motor control and safety applications.

Key Highlights:
• Sub-microsecond hardware overcurrent shutoff circuit.
• Opto-isolated signal paths shielding the STM32 microcontroller from motor switching noise.
• High-speed differential RS485 communication.
• Designed and routed entirely in KiCad.

projects.title: Autonomous Navigation Robot
projects.shortDesc: Closed-loop motor drive and obstacle avoidance platform built for national robotics competitions.

specs.Control Algorithm: Closed-Loop PID Velocity Control with Optical Encoders

projects.fullDescription:
Custom autonomous wheeled robot constructed for national robotics competitions.

Key Highlights:
• Closed-loop PID velocity control using quadrature optical encoders.
• Real-time ultrasonic ranging matrix calculating obstacle avoidance vectors.
• High-current MOSFET H-bridge motor drive.

resumeData.summary: Electrotechnics & Embedded Systems Engineer and Founder of Iotrixa (Arrêté 1275). Experienced in KiCad PCB design, power electronics, and real-time firmware development in Embedded C/C++ on STM32 and ESP32 with FreeRTOS.

education.degree: Master / MCIL in Electrotechnics & Embedded Systems
education.details: Power electronics, industrial motor drives, STM32/ESP32 microcontrollers, and automation.

bulletPoints: Designed custom single and multi-layer PCBs in KiCad with isolated ground planes and transient protection.
Architected IoT telemetry boards integrating ESP32-C3, AC-DC buck converters, and optoisolated relays.
Implemented MQTT over TLS communications with cloud dashboards for remote telemetry.
Designed motor driver circuits and closed-loop PID velocity control firmware.
Integrated ultrasonic sensor arrays and optical quadrature encoders for autonomous navigation.
